name: Hall Maximum Class
definition: The 299-concept maximum class $C_H\subseteq\{0,1\}^{12}$ of VC dimension three from the ancillary data of Chalopin--Chepoi--Moran--Warmuth, represented canonically by the database-owned 12-bit integer word list.
properties: It is maximum and hence ample, but it has no corner. All twenty-four elementary semicube restrictions and all twelve elementary coordinate contractions have complete corner peelings, so every proper pc-minor is dismantlable ample and $C_H$ is a pc-minimal obstruction.
